input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: Sections 11 and 12 contain no transition-assistance or data-export mechanic. Section 11.3 only survives certain sections, preserves Corio's existing Customer licence rights and support (subject to continued payment), and requires each party to return or destroy the other's Confidential Information - it gives Commerce One no obligation to assist Corio with migration and no obligation to export Corio's data within a fixed period. The escrow provisions in Section 12 release Source Code only on limited Release Conditions and are not an exit/data-return right. We therefore insert a short provision at the fallback level: at least 90 days of transition assistance on any expiration or termination, and export of our data within 30 days.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data export obligation in Section 11
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our playbook requires exit support, so we have added a short transition provision: on any expiration or termination Commerce One provides at least 90 days of transition assistance and exports our data within 30 days. This sits at our fallback position.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Data Export. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (a) provide transition assistance to Corio for at least ninety (90) days following such expiration or termination; and (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, export and deliver to Corio all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Corio or its Customers.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
